channel.title: APAC Legal News Digest
channel.description: Weekly digest of legal news covering Asia-Pacific jurisdictions, focused on technology law developments.

item.title: Weekly APJ Legal Digest — 30 Dec 2025 – 5 Jan 2026
item.description:
1. Australia Proposes New AI Safety Standards for High-Risk Systems

The Australian government has released draft AI safety standards requiring risk assessments for high-risk AI systems in healthcare, finance, and critical infrastructure. Public consultation closes March 2026.

Why it matters: Impacts AI development and deployment strategies.

ABC News • 02 Jan

2. Federal Court Rules on Data Breach Notification Timing

The Federal Court clarified that the 30-day notification requirement under the Privacy Act begins when an organization becomes aware of the breach, not when they complete their investigation.

Why it matters: Affects data handling and privacy compliance obligations.

Australian Financial Review • 30 Dec

3. MAS Issues Updated Cloud Computing Guidelines for Financial Institutions

The Monetary Authority of Singapore released revised guidelines requiring financial institutions to conduct annual cloud risk assessments and maintain detailed vendor registers.

Why it matters: Impacts cloud service agreements and vendor management.

Monetary Authority of Singapore • 03 Jan

4. Singapore Parliament Passes Digital Personal Data Protection Amendment

Amendments to the PDPA introduce mandatory data portability rights and increase maximum fines for violations to S$2 million, effective July 2026.

Why it matters: Affects data handling and privacy compliance obligations.

Channel NewsAsia • 04 Jan

5. Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission Updates Cross-Border Transfer Rules

New rules require organizations to obtain explicit consent for data transfers to countries without adequacy findings, with implementation beginning April 2026.

Why it matters: Affects data handling and privacy compliance obligations.

Nikkei Asia • 31 Dec

6. Commerce Commission Launches Market Study on Cloud Services

The Commerce Commission announced a comprehensive market study examining competition in cloud computing services, focusing on vendor lock-in and switching costs.

Why it matters: Impacts market strategy and merger activities.

NZ Herald • 02 Jan

7. Hong Kong Privacy Commissioner Issues Guidance on AI Processing

New guidance clarifies that AI systems processing personal data must comply with data protection principles, including accuracy and purpose limitation.

Why it matters: Impacts AI development and deployment strategies.

SCMP • 04 Jan

8. India's Digital Personal Data Protection Rules Released

The government published draft rules under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, introducing consent management requirements and data fiduciary obligations.

Why it matters: Affects data handling and privacy compliance obligations.

Economic Times • 05 Jan
